header: The page's plan for N64Recomp-browser's tools/play_page.mjs, its regular play of 2-3 minutes: the launcher, Load ROM
on a new profile, Start Game, then Start (Enter) through the logos, the opening and the title into Mushroom Village,
and A (Space) through Toad's messages and the warp pipe into the first board, as a player does on a new save. That is
the board Toad teaches the rules on (overlay 0x3E), which four computer players play with the board engine: dice,
spaces, a minigame's pick. Which screen is up is the overlay omOvlGotoEx last went to (0x800F09F4), the boards 0x36
(DK's Jungle Adventure) to 0x3E; a need fails the run unless the game is on a board. The page has no prebuilt shader
list yet, so its first minutes stutter as RT64 builds each pipeline.
